pricing.notes: INDIA PRICES NOT VERIFIED TODAY: graphy.com/pricing geo-redirects our (non-Indian) connection to graphy.com/us/pricing/, and graphy.com/in/pricing/ redirects too. The same page's server-rendered data contains conflicting INR figures: (a) a hidden India block 'Launch ₹1,999 per month *billed annually, 10% per sale or ₹10 whichever is higher' and 'Rise ₹9,999 per month *billed annually, 5% per sale or ₹10 whichever is higher', '*iOS app is available as a paid add-on'; (b) SEO meta description 'Launch plan ₹1,999 per month, growth plan ₹4,200 per month and rise plan ₹8,400 per month'; (c) hero 'oldPrice' 'Rs. 24999'. vs/graphy.html (17 Oct 2026) recorded Launch ₹24,999/yr 10%, Grow ₹49,999/yr 7.5%, Rise ₹99,999/yr 5% (or ₹10 if higher) — none of (a)-(c) matches that three-plan set. Do not publish INR Graphy plan prices until re-checked from an Indian IP.

sources.what_it_supports: US plan prices, 0% transaction fee, 14-day trial (redirect target of graphy.com/pricing from our region)
Embedded India block and meta description with conflicting INR figures (page data, not verified as what Indian visitors see)
